credit_estimate_note: The profile listed 1 credit per GPU-hour. The integer balance and displayed consumed value did not change, so 0.39 is a time-proportional estimate, not an observed charge.
source_transfer_workaround: The container could not validate GitHub TLS with its installed CA bundle, so the exact local git archive was SHA-256 verified, uploaded privately, and extracted on the PVC.
wrapper_workaround: The uploaded shell script required a session-only CRLF-to-LF conversion before bash execution.
